_comment: How the overworld spends itself once its god is dead. One entry per band;
band N applies at chapter band >= N and never reverses (docs/WORLD.md).
HARD GUARANTEE, enforced in code and asserted here so it is never lost:
the unraveling NEVER converts a player-placed block. It warps the world,
never the player's work. Every 'from' below is a naturally-generated vanilla
block; the runtime additionally consults placement tracking before touching
anything. A conversion that could eat a build is a design failure, not a
Direction follows the palette's semantic law -- cool means held, warm means
spent -- so conversions run intact -> loosened -> dry, never the reverse.

bands.note: Barely there, and only near the crater and the shrines. The world has not understood yet.
Everywhere now, and structural: what was bound begins to let go.
